answer: One defence is Certified bookkeeper registration with bookkeepers association attestation: a registration the association renews after ledger audits, and the saffron of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: a registration the association renews after ledger audits is fresh per account, and the knoll is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the inlet of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
